summary: @ornikar/repo-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is an obfuscated loader (hex-suffixed identifiers such as _0x488df8/_0x52943e, indirection wrappers like YCZJE/HWsee) that, on npm install, builds a URL of the form https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, downloads the Bun runtime archive, extracts the bun binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js]). math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header '// @bun @bun-cjs') using rotated string-array/decoder obfuscation (decoder hc1jfK9, hex-named variables). A repository-config/lint utility has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time and use it to execute an opaque obfuscated blob; this pattern evades tooling that only inspects Node-resolved code. The combination of alternate-runtime dropper at preinstall, obfuscated loader, and obfuscated Bun-compiled payload executed automatically satisfies the install-time remote-code-execution shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
